title: Security Effect and Institutional Policy authoritative glossary

records.definition: Action-scoped business-security reasoning domain that produces evidence-backed findings, assessments, constraints and unaffected abilities; not method authority or perimeter enforcement.
Immutable observed fact with provenance/time/access-surface context; not itself an accusation or enforcement decision.
Policy-controlled interpretation of one or more observations with confidence/support/counterevidence/validity.
Frozen time-bounded evidence/findings set used to evaluate an exact proposed action.
Deterministic action-specific result containing disposition, findings, evidence, unknowns, constraints, unaffected abilities and trace identity.
Security disposition requiring durable review or constrained flow; it is not itself a downstream business decision or account-control authority.
Shared fixed/versioned governance substrate for publication authority, effective-time lifecycle, replay, topology, rollout/promotion/rollback and deployment evidence.
Historical evaluation using the policy/deployment state actually operative at that time; distinct from labelled counterfactual replay.
Explicit service/region/channel/tenant/cohort routing of an exact reviewed policy artifact; topology is governance evidence, not customer-risk evidence.
Immutable Security evidence binding for an exact subject/object/class/method and Security trace; it grants no method authority.
Exact invocation id plus deterministic argument/context identity and observation time used to fence stale/substituted Security assessments.
Non-authoritative evidence linking an admitted/started operation to later commit revalidation, including host-supplied origin execution-evidence identity.
Exact staged-state/context observation immediately before irreversible publication; not proof that publication occurred.
Professional, evidence-based, proportionate institutional control: narrow dangerous capabilities while preserving safe service, without moral judgement or theatrical guardrails.

provenance.claim: Glossary is grounded in the published Security Effect architecture and API concepts.
Institutional Policy glossary terms derive from current shared governance mechanics.
